Caspase-3.reason: PMID 40943481 explicitly shows curcumin decreases cleaved caspase-3 (anti-apoptotic effect), directly contradicting the proposed upregulation. PMID 37258140 covers analogs, not curcumin itself. Source relation unsupported; contradiction invalidates composition.

Reactive Oxygen Species.reason: Both source PMIDs show curcumin scavenges/reduces ROS, contradicting the claim that curcumin increases ROS. Target PMIDs are reviews without mechanistic statements or show ROS downregulation in apoptosis without establishing ROS promotes apoptosis directionally. Composition invalid.

ICAM-1.reason: Source relation supported: senescence upregulates ICAM-1 across multiple PMIDs. Target PMIDs only mention ICAM-1 modulation in atherosclerosis context without explicit mechanistic evidence that ICAM-1 itself drives atherosclerotic progression; both are reviews or confounded observations.

PAI-1.reason: Source relation supported: PAI-1 mediates senescence bidirectionally. Target PMIDs lack explicit mechanistic support: PMID 12914731 is about testosterone/CAD, PMID 17334498 is a review noting PAI-1 role in fibrin deposition without directional mechanistic statement, PMID 36469488 is correlational thrombosis data.

c-Myc.reason: PMID 31604033 explicitly shows HBV triggers c-Myc upregulation via PTEN/beta-catenin signaling. PMIDs 36602428 and 40231634 mechanistically demonstrate c-Myc promotes HCC progression. Endpoints are semantically isolated across documents. Composition valid.

miR-122.reason: Direction of HBV effect on miR-122 is contradictory: PMID 41721392 shows steatosis promotes miR-122 suppressing HBV. miR-122 suppresses HCC per PMID 34623217 (radiosensitization), contradicting 'dysregulation promotes HCC.' Polarity inconsistent; composition invalid.

SIRT1.reason: Multiple PMIDs explicitly show SGLT2 inhibitors activate SIRT1. PMIDs 40257493 and 41033563 mechanistically demonstrate SIRT1 activation mediates renal protection in AKI models. Endpoints are semantically isolated. Signed composition valid.

TNF-alpha.reason: Source PMIDs do not explicitly show dysbiosis increases TNF-alpha with mechanistic direction; PMID 30622429 is a general review, PMID 40673809 involves NK/NF-κB not TNF-alpha, PMID 40714142 is obesity-focused. Target relation supported. Composition invalid due to unsupported source hop.
